meta.note: Seats won are the seats up in May; comp is the whole council after May (seats not up included). pc: chance of each control outcome. rg: seats won, 10th to 90th percentile. Great Yarmouth First (stood for the county as GYF (Restore)) is counted as Restore Britain (RES).
meta.sw: sw: per party [uniform swing in points needed for a majority, swing needed to be largest party], from the projection; negative = it has it now and keeps it until a swing of that size against it; -99 = keeps it beyond -15; councils needing more than +10 omitted.

meta.gb: Rebuilt pipeline (Nov 2026). England: each ward's latest result moved to today's polls by the J-curve, with a learned May-2026 adjustment for 2022-24 bases, county divisions shared out to district wards by a census model, by-election effects (census ridge + same-council term), own by-elections, a 50% floor for sitting independents and the Restore Britain overlay. Wales: 2022 results moved to the 2026 Senedd constituency results (60:40 with the 2022 pattern) then to the Senedd Nowcast. Scotland: 2022 first preferences moved to the GB Nowcast Scotland row; seats by Droop quota and largest remainder. national/control are Great Britain totals (ranges summed across nations); nations.E/W/S hold each nation.
meta.others: IND seats are named by the party of the ward's sitting councillor where that is a local or minor party (LOC localist, LIB Liberal, ASP Aspire, NIP, CIP, YRP Your Party, OTH other); ward field o names the IND vote share.
